Name: Tool Reskin - Wrapped Handles (in different colours) and Dark Wood
Author: TeaLovingLad
Description:
[size=4][size=3]The reskin of the main tools (hoe, pickaxe, axe and watering can) will be edited onto the original assets, which means, that any other reskins from other mods, that edit the appearance of the main tools, will interfere with this mod.
However, items like the [u]copper pan, milk pail, fishing rods, trash cans, scythes and shears will [b]remain unaffected[/b][/u] and mods which edit their appearance alone can be used alongside this mod![/size]

[b]
How to install one of the reskins:[/b][/size]

[size=3]- Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
- Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- Download the mod via [u]"Manual Download"[/u] from the "Files"-category [i](since there are multiple versions, it would most likely conflict when using "Mod Manager Download")[/i]
- Unpack the .zip file (e.g. [url=https://www.7-zip.de/]7-Zip[/url])
- Copy the folder with colour of your choice and paste it into Stardew Valley's "Mods"-folder

[b]And you're done! Enjoy![/b]



[b][center][u]Should you run into any issues when trying to get the reskin to work, don't be afraid to ask for help![/u][/center][/b]



[/size][center][size=3][b]Thank you, for at least considering to download my mod. Have a good one of whatever you feel like![/b][/size][/center]
